evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The assertion supplies a contrastive distinction that controls the framing of intelligence as owned versus rented.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: The sentence directs attention through a factual-seeming contrast between commodity substrate and retained perspective.
The statement explicitly frames the passage as a restatement of an existing thesis, supplying positioning rather than an influence tactic.
